In this experiment, you are to make two sets of measurements as accurately as you can in order to
determine the volume of a beaker.
Record all of your observations and answers on pages 4 and 5 of the Answer Booklet.
You are provided with a beaker, a rule, a length of string and two blocks of wood.
Carry out the following instructions.
